definition: [ לֹעַ ] noun [masculine] probably throat > (external) (compare Late Hebrew לוֺעַ jaw, cheek , Aramaic לוֺעָא , id. ); — וְשַׂמְתָּ֫ שַׂכִּין בְּלֹעֶ֑ךָ Prov 23:2 and thou shalt put a knife to thy throat (figurative for restraining oneself from indulgence in food).
